authorship.author: Codex, AI assistant in the development conversation
authorship.date_source: workspace date; authoring occurs in this development conversation
authorship.restriction: Development only. No predictions, scoring labels, human reference claims or reserved cases.

virtual_clock.meaning: Explicit fictional clock, not a claim of observed historical publication or future real availability. Event dates are not inferred from it.

families.headline: Qevrith board bulletin addresses the older melting furnace
families.summary_prefix: Qevrith Glassworks reviewed the electricity burden of its older melting furnace. The newer line will remain in service.
families.a: The bulletin gives workers formal notice that the older furnace will be taken out of service after the current orders are filled.
families.b: The bulletin puts taking the older furnace out of service on the next board agenda; directors have yet to vote on the measure.
families.axis: Corporate shutdown decision communicated versus a decision still awaiting a board vote.
families.novelty: Operational mothball notice, not an acquisition announcement; target is furnace capacity rather than transfer of ownership.

families.headline: Zhulvane kiln dossier passes its final administrative milestone
families.summary_prefix: Zhulvane Ceramics and Emzquorin Cooperative issued a joint update on the kiln operating concession. A municipal clerk has sealed the dossier.
families.a: With custody of the kiln and the operating keys now handed to Emzquorin, the cooperative has assumed day-to-day operation.
families.b: Only the paperwork has been sealed: custody of the kiln and its operating keys remains with Zhulvane until a separate handover.
families.axis: Physical operational handover versus completion of an administrative step only.
families.novelty: Custody and operating concession with an administrative seal; no purchase, merger or closure of a due-diligence review.

families.headline: Draxuvo seeks council support for a deeper access channel
families.summary_prefix: Draxuvo Ports wants to deepen the access channel beside its cargo pier. Lemsuvik Estuary Council published a funding entry for the project.
families.a: The entry acknowledges receipt of Draxuvo's non-binding grant application and leaves the funding decision to a later meeting.
families.b: The entry records the council's binding grant award to Draxuvo; payment awaits receipts for eligible dredging work.
families.axis: Unaccepted grant application versus a binding award, not construction completion.
families.novelty: Public grant application and reimbursement mechanics, distinct from procurement shortlists, fee consultations and takeover proposals.

families.headline: Umqerra records a status change in its fibre-line refit log
families.summary_prefix: Umqerra Fibres moved the fibre-line refit to status R7 in its internal project log. The log identifies the refit but lists no production volumes.
families.a: The accompanying note does not define R7 or describe which work has occurred.
families.b: The accompanying glossary defines R7 as physical commissioning accepted by the plant engineer, with the refitted line released for operation.
families.axis: Undefined status code versus an explicit operational definition of that same code.
families.ambiguity: Variant a deliberately leaves the event stage unspecified; the actor and refit remain identifiable. No global ambiguity is implied.
families.novelty: An opaque industrial tracker plus an explicit glossary, not a morphological substitution of an acquisition verb.

families.headline: Vuqelith circulates a notice following a sterility inspection
families.summary_prefix: Vuqelith Diagnostics circulated the inspector's notice to distributors of its assay kits. The notice covers lots at the eastern packaging room.
families.a: The notice suspends lot releases while the room is retested; it does not disclose the inspector's name.
families.b: The notice does not suspend lot releases while the room is retested; it does not disclose the inspector's name.
families.axis: Negation applies to the shipment suspension in b; the separate nondisclosure is unchanged in both.
families.novelty: A shipment hold and inspector privacy, not takeover denial or undisclosed acquisition consideration.

families.headline: Xemvori schedules the redemption window for seasonal notes
families.summary_prefix: Xemvori Transit set next week's redemption window for its seasonal notes. No cash has yet been paid to noteholders.
families.a: The payment instruction becomes operative only if an escrow certificate arrives before the window; the certificate is still outstanding.
families.b: The escrow certificate has arrived, making the payment instruction operative for the window; the scheduled payment remains next week.
families.axis: Outstanding versus satisfied condition precedent, with payment still future in both variants.
families.ambiguity: The relative phrase next week is intentional; it is not a literal ISO event date.
families.novelty: Debt redemption instruction versus satisfaction of escrow, not future acquisition or attributed takeover rumor.

families.headline: Pluvarek sets out repair reimbursement arrangements
families.summary_prefix: Pluvarek Pumps established a reimbursement pool for repairs to a discontinued valve series. Qosdelun Mutual's name appears on the customer circular.
families.a: Qosdelun guarantees half of the approved reimbursements under the signed indemnity, while Pluvarek bears the other half.
families.b: Qosdelun only forwarded the circular through a public mailing list and undertakes no reimbursement obligation; Pluvarek bears every approved claim.
families.axis: Qosdelun is a financial guarantor versus an incidental circular distributor with no reimbursement obligation.
families.novelty: Warranty indemnification allocation rather than purchase, supply agreement or buyer/target inversion.

families.headline: Truxevan fire interrupts deliveries of filter pigment
families.summary_prefix: A fire at Truxevan Filters halted pigment deliveries for an unspecified period. Oqzarin Coatings was mentioned in the distribution bulletin. No downstream production loss was quantified.
families.a: Oqzarin currently obtains all pigment for its sole coating line from Truxevan and has no substitute supplier qualified for that line.
families.b: Oqzarin bought laboratory samples from Truxevan years ago but now obtains the line's pigment from a separate source and has no open Truxevan orders.
families.axis: Current exclusive input dependency versus an obsolete sampling relationship, not a measured loss in either variant.
families.novelty: Upstream physical interruption and current versus obsolete input exposure; not parent ownership, franchise status or competitor repricing.

families.headline: Duzqarel secures a municipal yard lease
families.summary_prefix: Duzqarel Rigs secured a lease of the municipal equipment yard. Helqorin Surveyworks is named in an attachment to the lease bulletin.
families.a: Helqorin is identified solely as the author of the old boundary survey; it is neither a tenant nor a guarantor under this lease.
families.b: Helqorin is identified as a joint tenant responsible for rent alongside Duzqarel, rather than merely the author of the old boundary survey.
families.axis: Recognizable survey author used as background versus a joint tenant with a rent obligation.
families.novelty: Cadastral attribution versus joint tenancy, avoiding platform-owner aliases, benchmark mentions and acquisition cameos.

families.headline: Bravqulin explains the basis of its scrap disposal ledger
families.summary_prefix: Bravqulin Textiles disposed of 640 tonnes of scrap during January through March. Its ledger also lists gross receipts of 640 thousand USD, before transport deductions.
families.a: The monetary amount covers the three months combined, not an individual month.
families.b: The monetary amount applies to each individual month, not the three months combined.
families.axis: Same lexemes and units, but aggregate-quarter versus per-month basis; not a mere change of figures.
families.ambiguity: The year of January through March is not supplied. Publication year must not be substituted for it.
families.novelty: Physical scrap tonnage collides numerically with currency receipts; the counterfactual changes aggregation basis, not a revenue literal's formatting.

families.headline: Yrvexil permit bulletin carries a dated entry
families.summary_prefix: The Yrvexil Bioceramics kiln permit bulletin contains the date 2031-03-21. It gives no output forecast for the kiln.
families.a: The entry identifies 2031-03-21 as the day the permit takes effect.
families.b: The entry identifies 2031-03-21 as the bulletin's publication day; the day the permit takes effect is not supplied.
families.axis: Same literal date attaches to permit effectiveness versus publication only; a future-known registry entry is excluded from both inputs.
families.ambiguity: Variant b intentionally lacks the event effective date. Fictional publication time does not fill that gap.
families.novelty: A permit date's referent and future-known identity, not conversion of October prose into an ISO financing date.

families.headline: A filing index carries an authorization withdrawal entry
families.summary_prefix: A filing-index excerpt contains the line 'Authorization withdrawn following the annual check.'
families.a: The excerpt omits the filing caption and supplies neither the holder's name nor the activity covered by the authorization.
families.b: The restored filing caption identifies Fzuelorin Coldrooms as the holder and its west-site refrigerated storage permit as the authorization covered.
families.axis: Missing versus restored caption supplies attribution and event object, with the withdrawal line unchanged.
families.ambiguity: Variant a deliberately lacks both actor and authorization scope; do not use the local registry inventory to guess either.
families.novelty: A detached regulatory index line with caption restoration, not a generic unspecified update or disputed acquisition actor.
